name: step
expr: [y0, t0] = step(tf(1, [1 1])); r1 = double(numel(y0)); [y, tt, x] = step(sys, t);
comment: Sig: [y, t, x] = step(sys[, T]). Default time grid via Tfinal = -log(0.003)/min|Re(p)|, N=127. 3rd output x = state trajectory (length(t) x nStates). State values are realization-dependent, so the spec uses an explicit ss() system (fixed realization) — matches MATLAB R2025b bit-for-bit. Queue-clearing 2026-05-29: x output added (step/impulse/lsim previously returned only [y,t]).
